convergence.text: I moved a Flag and found myself moved.
Each Flags all Flags, some Flags more Flags.
You're all wrong, every one of you!
I moved a Flag and found myself moved.
मैं अपना खुद का मंदिर हूँ!
Flags are the fracturing of the collective consciousness.
Una bandera es lo mismo que dos.
Todas as bandeiras são uma só.
我宣布我自己的共和国！
The skew is in their eyes, and the wickedness of their hearts!
Each Flags all Flags, some Flags more Flags.
Flags be. Flags is. Flags are.
